Q: Modify numeric values with Perl one-liner A:

Given the nice structure of your file (CSV) and its simplicity (only contains numbers which use . as decimal separator), I think that it would be easier to use autosplit (-a) rather than a regex:

perl -F, -ane '$F[0]++; $F[1]++; print join ",", @F'

(the -F, flag tells Perl to split on commas instead of spaces)

Q: Ruby: how to generate HTML from Markdown like GitHub's or BitBucket's? A:

You can use https://github.com/ethos-link/git-markdown

Per their documentation:

# Export PR from current repository
git-markdown pr 123

And you get an MD file with the PR review comments and code references.
